desc: Derive the exact tree/forest interpretation of the operation and prove how a selected valid substring transforms sibling subtrees.
Characterize all reachable forests and determine that every plane embedding of the same unordered rooted forest is reachable.
Design and justify the recurrence counting distinct reachable strings without ambiguity or duplicate counting.
Prove correctness by induction on the parenthesis structure, including identical subtrees, repeated components, and edge cases.
Implement the algorithm with modulo \(998244353\) and efficient bottom-up canonical type construction.
Validate the algorithm against the provided samples.
